### SOL-2 — Pre-output Lint / Self-Audit Gate
- What it does: Before output, auto-check: 'Did I resolve authoritative definitions? Did I drift?' If yes, autocorrect + log.
- Generalizable scope: All plan/spec/emission outputs that reference canonical objects.
- Applicability: Global (planner + emitters).
- Limits / prerequisites: Needs rule set + standardized output markers to lint.

### SOL-3 — Variant Drift Detection
- What it does: Detect multiple variants of a concept across artifacts; prevent conflation; force selection of canonical version.
